meta.method: Two-game empirical-Bayes shrinkage of observed per-game production, adjusted for projected pace, game script, opponent efficiency and implied team scoring.
limitations: Current build uses season aggregates rather than a complete frozen player-game variance ledger.
Point estimates remain research forecasts until prospective error calibration is complete.
Availability context is shown only when a current source-linked report exists.
The board contains no player market lines, odds, prices, picks, or wager tracking.
